items.about: Telangana is asking startups to solve seven concrete public-sector problems — led by low-cost solar irrigation for deep borewells — with the reward being paid government pilots that can turn into long-term procurement contracts. Shortlisted teams will be showcased at the Invest Telangana Global Summit in December 2026. Deadline 30 Nov 2026. The seven challenges: solar irrigation pumps/retrofit kits for deep borewells (~30% cheaper, theft-resistant panels, tamper-proof metering); rapid food-adulteration testing for hostels; satellite monitoring of lake and land encroachment; automated pothole mapping and repair; needle-free anaemia screening; AI-based Telugu reading assessment; satellite/app-based crop mapping. No cash prize announced — the value is the pilot and contract pathway.
items.eligibility:
Startups, innovators, researchers, technology firms and academic institutions
Applicants from anywhere in India (and international innovation centres) may apply
Solution must address one of the seven listed problem statements
Judged on problem relevance, originality, technology readiness, team capability and impact
items.benefits:
Pilot deployment with Telangana government departments
Route to long-term government procurement contracts, subject to pilot results
Showcase slot at the Invest Telangana Global Summit 2026 (Bharat Future City, December)
Direct engagement with state officials on real-world problems
